listing.name: Worldsmith Console Commands 1.1.1
listing.summary: (Starsector 0.98a-RC8): reshape the sector from the console. Create planets, stars (might still be a little buggy) and whole star systems, terraform instantly, found new factions (yes this works, you can also custamize them a lot, check the readme or github description), start total war or plunge the sector into an apocalypse. Needs Console Commands, LazyLib and Nexerelin; can be added mid-save, not removed. Most Information on GitHub or the Readme https://github.com/tofife999-glitch/WorldsmithConsoleCommands/releases/latest Extra: Much of the code (95%) is AI written. My involvement in the code was mostly early on and then some bug fixing, I have tested every command in multiple ways multiple times and they all worked for me, but there might still be bugs. should also run on java 27, with the updated mikohime and fr.
